# CLI Reference

The `archetype` CLI is built with [Typer](https://typer.tiangolo.com/). Install via `uv sync` or `pip install -e .`.

The CLI is a thin HTTP client — every command (except `serve`) delegates to a running `archetype serve` instance.

## Commands

### `archetype invoke`

Send one exact operation document (including create, compose, admit or fork).

```bash
archetype invoke <REQUEST> [OPTIONS]
```

**Arguments:**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `REQUEST` | path | Yes |  |

**Options:**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--url` | text | — |  |
| `--token` | text | — |  |

---

### `archetype serve`

Start the configured authenticated HTTP/MCP host. No developer-role credentials.

```bash
archetype serve [OPTIONS]
```

**Options:**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--host` | text | `127.0.0.1` |  |
| `--port` | integer | `8000` |  |

---

## `archetype world`

Explicit world lifecycle and complete-cut history

### `archetype world history`

```bash
archetype world history <RESOURCE> [OPTIONS]
```

**Arguments:**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `RESOURCE` | text | Yes |  |

**Options:**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--offset` | integer | `0` |  |
| `--limit` | integer | `32` |  |
| `--url` | text | — |  |
| `--token` | text | — |  |

---
